title: Tech Note: Taking Advantage of Execute on Server

historical_commentary.text: The core problem this note solves — minimizing network chatter in Client/Server 4D applications by running bulk operations on the server rather than the client — remains a foundational performance consideration in 4D applications today, and the EXECUTE ON SERVER command (and its language successors) is still part of the current 4D classic language. The specific 1990s/2000s Client/Server networking constraints described are less severe on modern hardware and networks, but the architectural principle of minimizing client-server round trips for bulk data operations is timeless and still taught to 4D developers.
related_updates: EXECUTE ON SERVER remains part of the modern 4D language for offloading client operations to the server
ORDA's entity selections and REST-based data access (2018+) introduced additional patterns for controlling where and how data operations execute in client/server 4D apps
